query.name: us.ma.k12.lawrence.classdojo.orgs
query.sql: (select cast ((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) as sourcedId, cast ((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtname') as varchar2(50)) as name, 'district' as type, null as parentSourceId from dual) union all (select cast(schools.school_number as varchar2(10)) as sourcedId, schools.name as name, 'school' as type, cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) as parentSourcedId from schools left join ( select s.schoolid, COUNT(s.ID) as NO_OF_SECTIONS from sections s join terms tb on tb.id=s.termid and tb.schoolid=s.schoolid where tb.lastday>=sysdate GROUP BY s.schoolid ORDER BY NO_OF_SECTIONS DESC ) q ON schools.SCHOOL_NUMBER = q.schoolid )
